sources.title: Should Giants trade for Jonathan Taylor? What's next for Kirk Cousins, Chiefs WRs? NFL trade deadline questions emerge from Sunday's games
sources.description: Taylor may help, albeit without seeming necessary, for the Giants to win the NFC East. Meanwhile, a league source thought a third-round pick would compel the Raiders to send Cousins to Minnesota.
